request.query: LiouvilleWith p algebraic real implies p at most two

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mono
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q ≤ p → LiouvilleWith q x

items.name: LiouvilleWith.irrational
items.type: ∀ {p x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → 1 < p → Irrational x

items.name: forall_liouvilleWith_iff
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, (∀ (p : ℝ), LiouvilleWith p x) ↔ Liouville x

items.name: volume_iUnion_setOf_liouvilleWith
items.type: MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ p, ⋃ (_ : 2 < p), {x | LiouvilleWith p x}) = 0
